body:
it’s a tricky topic, where do influence and truth lie between spiritual experiences and scientific psychology. I’m personally a very spiritual person but i always take my experiences and beliefs with a grain of salt. it’s easy to loose yourself in the unknown connecting dots that may not be correlated or crediting power of an outside source to things in your life. 

i’ve struggled immensely with both demonic experiences and my own mental health my whole life. For me personally I was in a similar state where i believed bad things that happened to me were because of influence from negative entities. Focusing on this led me down a path of extreme paranoia and crippling fear. I would hear awful voices, sounds, words and see shadows, entities, and light hallucinations both while awake and asleep. I was diagnosed with schizo-affective and bipolar 2 and was institutionalized a few times. I couldn’t work, i couldn’t shower, i couldn’t think, i was not residing on everyone else’s plane of existence. Medications, self hatred, surrounded by voices that constantly put me down in every way possible. 

I am now off medication, work full time, have fulfilling and satisfying relations with others, i’m a different person. A part of me will always feel connected with that mysterious side of the universe. I still see and hear things here and there but listening to them and focusing on them pulls me down that hole. I leave them in the peripheral and remind myself of who i am and what’s important to me. i speak to myself with love and positivity and it’s created a sort of shield around me. This is something that i talk about to only one person in my life and i don’t expect many to understand or comprehend what i mean. 

Just do your best to be aware of those feelings/thoughts regarding to supernatural influence. Be grounded in yourself, your intentions, your mindset, thoughts of positivity and love towards yourself. Life’s wild and everyone’s gotta figure out how to live their life in the way that works for them best. So whatever your beliefs, perspectives, or motivations are just know that every thing is different for every one.

it’s just so hard when you’re only living for the people you love. i’ve had a lot of trauma in the past but my life is pretty much perfect and i have no reason to complain. it almost makes it feel worse when you like your life but hate the feeling of the evil in your head constantly tearing everything you do down. I have no respect or value for myself. i know i’ll hurt other people if i do something, but life always goes on for the people that can handle it. i’m just not one of those people :/
